Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private deployment options — quick post-call recap + asks

Hi Alice / team — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a short set of asks so we can size the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and prepare the network deep-dive: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary objective: run customer-facing LLM features behind GloboBank's controlled network boundary (sensitive PII workloads).
- Preference: Private deployment if we can meet egress and firewall constraints; leaning toward PrivateLink but evaluating peering if static outbound IPs are required.
- Expected traffic: ~2.5k rps at peak for embeddings + chat in first quarter of production (approx 30k tokens/min).

Asks we need to confirm before we schedule the network deep-dive (items 1–6 are blockers for a Private VPC plan):
1) PrivateLink vs VPC Peering: do you have a strict requirement for peering (layer-3 access) or would a PrivateLink endpoint be acceptable? If PrivateLink is acceptable, can you confirm whether you require mutual TLS on the PrivateLink interface?
2) Egress IPs / allowlist: does your firewall require a fixed set of outbound IPs to allow? If yes, please confirm whether a small set of stable egress IPs (up to ~8) behind a NAT gateway is acceptable, or whether you need a dedicated, single static IP per customer.
3) DNS / outbound connectivity pattern: will the network team accept DNS resolution via private hosted zones, or do you need egress to your global resolver? Also confirm whether you have concerns about TLS SNI inspection that could break upstream TLS.
4) Proxy / inspection: do requests to our private endpoint transit a corporate HTTP proxy with authentication? If so, we need proxy details (auth type, header/pass-through).
5) Certificate and key handling: for mutual TLS or client certs, confirm if you manage client certs centrally (Y/N) and whether we should prepare for JKS/pfx delivery.
6) Timeline & point of contact: named network/security engineer for the deep-dive and target week for implementation.

Attached: network_requirements_template.xlsx (fills our typical preflight info) and a draft mutual action plan.

Next steps we propose:
- If you confirm (1) PrivateLink is acceptable, and (2) egress IP constraints are as described above, we can schedule the network deep-dive for next week with our infra team (Vivek) and solutions engineering (Ben).
- If peering is mandatory, we’ll prep a peering architecture note and capacity plan (this typically adds 2–3 business days to the timeline).

Thanks — draft next steps in-line so we can jump into scheduling.

— Priyom

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the clear summary. Some quick clarifications from our side: 

- PrivateLink is preferred for our cloud-hosted services because it keeps traffic on the provider backbone and simplifies routing. We are open to peering only if PrivateLink cannot provide the guarantee we need on outbound egress IPs.
- Egress IPs: our corporate firewall team requires a stable set of outbound IPs to allow; ideally a predictable CIDR or a short list of static IPs. We understand you may use a NAT gateway; confirm whether Redwood can publish the egress IP list for a Dedicated/Private customer.
- mTLS: We would like mutual TLS on the PrivateLink interface for app-to-app authentication. We manage certs via our internal PKI; we can provide cert material ahead of the deep-dive.
- DNS: we prefer to keep DNS resolution internal. If PrivateLink is used, we'd like to keep requests resolving to private endpoints.
- Proxy/inspection: we do not run an authenticated corporate proxy in front of PrivateLink traffic. There is TLS inspection on egress for certain ranges — we will include details in the network team notes.

Point of contact: forwarding this to netops@globobank.com (Nick Ramos) and security_ops@globobank.com (Maya Patel) — they can join the deep-dive. Proposed week: Mar 6–10 (US/Eastern).

Alice Turner
Product Security Lead | GloboBank
